name: CopyButton
usage: Copying tokens, links, IDs and code examples

props.name: label
props.description:
Label: the text of the button with `showLabel`, otherwise the tooltip and the accessible name. "Copy" by
default (follows `locale`).

props.name: showLabel
props.description:
Shows the label next to the icon (a Button); by default only the icon is shown (an IconButton with a
tooltip).

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the icon-only button: `sm` inside code blocks and list items, `md` in toolbars.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called after the text has been written to the clipboard.

props.name: onError
props.description:
Called when copying fails: the Clipboard API is not available (it requires a secure context, HTTPS or
localhost) or the browser refused to write. The button shows the failed state either way; without `onError`
the error is reported with `reportError`.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: An icon button with a tooltip next to the text it copies. After copying, the icon turns into a check mark.

examples.name: WithLabel
examples.title: With a label
examples.description: `showLabel` shows the label next to the icon, for a copy action that deserves a button of its own.

examples.name: Failure
examples.title: Handling failures
examples.description:
Copying fails without a secure context (HTTPS) or when the browser refuses; the button shows the failed state
and `onError` receives the error.
